title: OpenIslet contribution ledger record
description: One record per submission, derived from its public GitHub issue. The id is IIP- plus the issue number padded to four digits, so IIP-0001 is issue 1 (the founding record). The website's Contributions page reads these records. There are no scores: a person decides each IIP's outcome and writes it in words, and later events are added as follow-ups. Nothing in this schema involves payment.

status.description: Where the submission is: queued (software checks done), closed-triage (set aside in the weekly review, with a public reason), reviewed (examined in the weekly review), then merged, declined or needs-work. The website groups queued and reviewed as 'review'.

target_version.description: The version it was written against, such as islet-1-draft or islet-1.1.

landed_in.description: The locked version the accepted change first appears in. Null until it is merged and a version is locked.

handle.description: A public GitHub handle. GitHub is the only sign-in.

name.description: A display name the contributor typed on the submission form. Shown as typed, not checked.

orcid.description: An ORCID iD the contributor typed on the submission form. Checked for shape and check digit, never verified as theirs, so verified.orcid stays false.

x.description: An X handle the contributor typed on the submission form, without the @. Shown as typed, not checked.

ror.description: Optional Research Organization Registry id for a lab.

ai_tools.description: Model names and effort settings as the contributor reported them. Never shown as verified.

models.description: Every model the contributor reported, when the contribution is not a single draft and review (for example the founding blueprint). Never shown as verified.

outcome.description: What a person decided the IIP did, in words. Null until then. The four kinds changed_blueprint, dead_end, evidence and open_question are named in the next locked version. There are no scores or weights.

note.description: One plain sentence: what it changed, or why not.

where.description: Where it landed on openislet.org: a blueprint section, an Idea Graveyard entry or an open question.

with.description: Other IIPs credited for the same change (reviewed in the same week).

same_as.description: For already_covered: the IIP that had it first.

key_change.description: Set when a version is locked: one of the changes that mattered most in it.

follow_ups.description: What happened later, newest last: a later IIP built on it, a lab tested it, or its outcome was changed (with the reason). Nothing is removed.

ref.description: The IIP or lab result it refers to, such as IIP-0057.
